steps.name: Third: organize goals and initiatives on the Star Chart
steps.done_when: For a new mother ship, start in Star Chart with Aladdin as default steward; choose a dev-drive storage directory when available or another location, brainstorm major goals and their initiatives/deliverables, identify source material, and require at least one goal/initiative before previewing populated Star Chart and Cave. Existing-host clients reuse its organization.

steps.name: First: choose or connect to the mother ship
steps.done_when: On first launch choose this computer as the personal mother ship or connect to an existing personal host through a guided Tailscale and secure pairing-token flow. Install Anchor and Foundry skills only on a new mother ship; client devices use that host.

steps.name: Provider capacity, cost and model controls
steps.done_when: Refine the interactive Setup sequence and shared provider surface with multiple subscriptions per provider, test/report feedback, remaining allowance and API cost, warning threshold and full-strength versus tier-down model policy; keep credentials/tests on the selected mother ship. John reviews before an implementation plan or build.
steps.waiting_on: Setup mockup Refinement 1: keep full strength and warn at low allowance, or automatically reduce model strength?

steps.name: Review Setup before building it
steps.done_when: Settle load-bearing choices and review the user-facing Setup flow.

steps.name: Second: connect subscriptions and optional API keys
steps.done_when: After host connection, show a provider checklist allowing multiple separately named subscriptions per provider and optional API connections. Normal sign-in, credentials, tests and usage reports belong to the mother ship; show per-connection capacity, cost and honest unknowns.

steps.name: Optional: connect calendars and email
steps.done_when: After provider setup, expose a separate optional calendars/email button for Outlook and Gmail. Secure sign-in and integration run on the mother ship; this does not block independent personal-host or goal organization work.

steps.name: Backups and restore
steps.done_when: Set up backups from the chosen project mapping and main directory.
